title: 世界西洋棋冠軍賽在日內瓦開打，前三盤全和
paras: The World Chess Championship match has begun in Geneva, Switzerland. The reigning champion, Gukesh Dommaraju of India, is defending his title against Javokhir Sindarov of Uzbekistan. Both players are only 20 years old. Sindarov earned his place by winning the Candidates Tournament, which decides the challenger.

The match has 14 classical games, and the first player to reach 7.5 points wins. A win is worth one point and a draw is worth half a point. The first three games all ended in draws, so the score is level at 1.5 to 1.5. If the match is still tied after 14 games, faster tiebreak games will be played on December 12.

questions.q: How did Sindarov earn the right to play for the title?
options: He was chosen by the city of Geneva
questions.why: 第一段：Sindarov 贏得挑戰者錦標賽（Candidates Tournament），取得挑戰冠軍的資格。

questions.q: What is the score after three games?
questions.why: 第二段：前三盤都是和局，每盤各得半分，比分 1.5 比 1.5。
